questions.question: If a and b are the roots of the equation x² – 7x + 12 = 0, then the value of (a³+b³)/(a²+b²+1) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The equation is x² – 7x + 12 = 0

Roots are a and b

**Concept Used:**

Sum and product of roots of a quadratic equation ax² + bx + c = 0

Sum of roots: a + b = -b/a

Product of roots: ab = c/a

**Formula Used:**

Sum of roots: a + b = 7

Product of roots: ab = 12

(a³ + b³)/(a² + b² + 1)

**Calculation:**

a + b = 7

ab = 12

a³ + b³ = (a + b)(a² - ab + b²)

⇒ a³ + b³ = 7(a² - 12 + b²)

⇒ a³ + b³ = 7(a² + b² - 12)

a² + b² = (a + b)² - 2ab

⇒ a² + b² = 7² - 2 × 12

⇒ a² + b² = 49 - 24

⇒ a² + b² = 25

⇒ a³ + b³ = 7(25 - 12)

⇒ a³ + b³ = 7 × 13

⇒ a³ + b³ = 91

a³ + b³/(a² + b² + 1)

⇒ 91 / (25 + 1)

⇒ 91 / 26

⇒ 3.5

**∴ The value of (a³ + b³)/(a² + b² + 1) is 3.5.**

questions.question: The normal systolic and diastolic pressure in humans is __________, respectively.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**120 and 80 mm of Hg**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **120 and 80 mm of Hg** are the **normal systolic and diastolic pressures in humans**, respectively.
 
• Systolic pressure (**120 mm of Hg**) is the **pressure in the arteries** when the **heart beats**.
 
• Diastolic pressure (**80 mm of Hg**) is the **pressure in the arteries** when the **heart rests between beats**.
 
• Maintaining normal blood pressure is crucial for health as high or low blood pressure can lead to various health issues.
 
• Regular monitoring and a healthy lifestyle can help maintain normal blood pressure levels.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Blood pressure** is measured in **millimeters of mercury** (mm of Hg) and recorded with two numbers.
 
• The **first number** (systolic pressure) measures the pressure in your blood vessels when your heart beats.
 
• The **second number** (diastolic pressure) measures the pressure in your blood vessels when your heart rests between beats.
 
• High blood pressure, or **hypertension**, can lead to serious health problems such as **heart disease, stroke, and kidney disease**.
 
• Low blood pressure, or **hypotension**, can cause **dizziness and fainting **and may indicate underlying health issues.
 
• Factors influencing blood pressure include diet, exercise, stress, and genetics.

• **Anthrax** is a serious **infectious disease** caused by gram-positive, rod-shaped bacteria known as **Bacillus anthracis**.
 
• **Elephantiasis** is caused by** parasitic worms** and results in **extreme swelling of body parts**, typically the legs.
 
• HIV is primarily transmitted through **unprotected sex, sharing needles, and from mother to child during birth or breastfeeding**.
 
• Early detection and consistent treatment of HIV can prevent the progression to AIDS.

• This discovery was crucial in the development of the field of spectroscopy, which analyzes the light spectrum to understand the properties of light-emitting substances.
 
• Dispersion is not limited to prisms; it can also be observed in natural phenomena such as rainbows, where water droplets in the atmosphere act as prisms.
 
• In addition to prisms, other devices like **diffraction gratings** can also disperse light into its spectral components.

__
 
• A freely suspended bar magnet aligns itself in the **Geographical North - Geographical South** direction.
 
• This phenomenon occurs because the Earth itself acts like a giant magnet with its magnetic field.
 
• The end of the bar magnet that points towards the geographical north is called the **North Pole** or **North-seeking pole**.
 
• Similarly, the end pointing towards the geographical south is known as the **South Pole** or **South-seeking pole**.
 
• This **alignment is due to the magnet's interaction with the Earth's magnetic field**, which exerts a torque on the magnet until it aligns with the field.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Earth's magnetic field is not perfectly aligned with its geographical axis; it is **tilted by about 11 degrees**.
 
• The geographical north corresponds to the magnetic south pole, and the geographical south corresponds to the magnetic north pole.
 
• This is why the north pole of a magnet points towards the geographical north, as opposite poles attract.
 
• Understanding this property of magnets is fundamental in navigation and has been utilized for centuries in compasses.

questions.question: If the simple interest on a certain sum for 18 months at 5.5% per annum exceeds the simple interest on the same sum for 14 months at 6% per annum by Rs. 62.50, then the sum is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Simple Interest for 18 months at 5.5% per annum exceeds the Simple Interest for 14 months at 6% per annum by Rs. 62.50.

**Concept and Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (Principal × Rate × Time) / 100

Let the Principal be P.

**Calculation:**

Simple Interest for 18 months (1.5 years) at 5.5% per annum:

⇒ SI₁ = (P × 5.5 × 1.5) / 100

⇒ SI₁ = (P × 8.25) / 100

Simple Interest for 14 months (14/12 years = 7/6 years) at 6% per annum:

⇒ SI₂ = (P × 6 × 7/6) / 100

⇒ SI₂ = (P × 7) / 100

⇒ (P × 8.25) / 100 - (P × 7) / 100 = 62.50

⇒ (P × (8.25 - 7)) / 100 = 62.50

⇒ (P × 1.25) / 100 = 62.50

⇒ P × 1.25 = 62.50 × 100

⇒ P × 1.25 = 6250

⇒ P = 6250 / 1.25

⇒ P = 5000

**∴ The sum is Rs. 5,000**
